A '''Decimator Facility''' was a large structure constructed by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] to support [[Decimator (war machine)|Decimator]] operations during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Located on [[Eredenn Prime|Eredenn]], they were captured by [[Sev'rance Tann/Legends|Sev'rance Tann]] when she [[Battle of Eredenn|raided]] the planet. Other facilities were located on [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]].
